summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 10 had no etcd package, so binaries were fetched from upstream GitHub release, wired into systemd, and firewalld's built-in etcd-client/etcd-server services were enabled). Loaded application keys under /app/*, confirmed replication and a healthy baseline. Simulated node3's member being permanently lost (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory), removed the stale member via node1/node2 while preserving 2-node quorum and verifying data was still intact, then added a new node3 member and bootstrapped a fresh etcd instance there in existing-cluster mode. Cluster returned to 3 healthy members with all application keys replicated onto the rebuilt node3. Finally, executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (systemd reboot), confirming boot_id changes and full cluster health/quorum/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.7.1 binaries on node1, node2, node3 from upstream GitHub release
Configured firewalld etcd-client/etcd-server services and systemd etcd.service unit on all nodes
Bootstrapped a new 3-member etcd cluster (node1,node2,node3) with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=new
Wrote application keys /app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag_x, /app/counters/orders and verified replication
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped etcd, deleted /var/lib/etcd contents on node3
Removed the dead member (6bb37665c452b40a) from the cluster via node1/node2 while preserving quorum, verified data intact on 2 nodes
Added a new member entry for node3 and re-bootstrapped etcd there with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing
Verified cluster returned to 3 healthy members with matching raft index and all application keys intact
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd/data health baseline on all 3 nodes
Sequentially restarted node1, node2, node3 via systemctl reboot, one at a time
Verified boot_id changed after each restart and cluster health/quorum/data recovered before moving to the next node
